# Security Policy

## Supported versions

Only the latest release of this package receives security fixes.
Please make sure you are running an up-to-date version before
reporting an issue.

## Reporting a vulnerability

**Do not open a public issue for security vulnerabilities.**

Preferred: use GitHub's private vulnerability reporting
(**Security → Report a vulnerability** on this repository).

Alternatively, contact the maintainer directly at
**jhunu.fernandes@gmail.com**.

You can expect an initial response within a few days. Once a fix is
available, it will be released and the advisory disclosed publicly.
